reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags the same issue multiple times for PhiFactory.createArt: the art-creation signature does not bind CreateConfig (artist/receiver/fees/etc.) or the caller, lacks a nonce/used-sig tracking (and sometimes chainId), enabling front‑running/replay so an attacker can set themselves as artist/receiver and capture royalties. The attack path and impacts (impersonation, fee/royalty theft, control over settings) match the vulnerability description. The proposed fixes (bind CreateConfig and/or caller in the signed payload, add nonce/consumption, chainId) would fix both, so it is the same vulnerability and code path.
